durable_results.statement: For K=H(H^T H+g^2I)^(-1)H^T, sum_{j!=i} det K[{i,j}] = K_ii trK-(K^2)_ii >=K_ii(trK-1). Thus trK>=2-epsilon and K_ii>1-epsilon imply attached two-row area >(1-epsilon)^2. Deleting row i loses at most K_ii effective ridge dimension.

For disjoint original-coordinate product banks with orthonormal 2D projections U,V and invertible D, the affine bilinear form 2U^T D V+alpha^TU+beta^TV+c has density sup <=e sqrt(2pi)/sigma_min(D); an independent remainder may be added.

Near-coloop plus the partner transverse reserve does not force one uniformly conditioned physical 2x2 pair. Exact target family A=[[0,H],[H^T,0]] with H rows u,v/sqrt(N),...,v/sqrt(N) has spectrum {1,1,-1,-1}, constant aggregate ridge area, but all physical pair magnitudes <=1/sqrt(M).
